hints.title: Direct Permutation Lookup
hints.text: Each element in the result array is determined directly by accessing nums at index nums[i].

hints.title: Standard Array Construction
hints.text: construct a new array of length n and assign ans[i] = nums[nums[i]].

hints.title: In-Place Base-N Encoding
hints.text: for an in-place O(1) space solution, encode both the original and new value into each element using modular arithmetic: nums[i] += (nums[nums[i]] % n) * n.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Constructs permutation array directly via list comprehension in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Modifying values in place naively overwrites original numbers before they are referenced by subsequent elements.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Straightforward allocation uses O(N) time and O(N) space, while modular encoding achieves O(1) extra space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should quickly provide the direct lookup and discuss in-place encoding using base N arithmetic.
